options: Remove stage 1 (stage 0 already covers their bond)
Rewrite to what is shown: Raina is amazed to see on Centipede's feed that Mike survived (S1#10)
owner_calls.evidence: S1#10 'The Bridge': 'Po and Raina look through his feed... Raina is amazed that Peterson is alive.' S1#11: 'the team rescues him after capturing Raina'; 'Peterson is alive... with an explosive surveillance eye implanted in him by someone working for the Clairvoyant.'

owner_calls.question: Stage 0 (S2#15) says Gonzales first insists on following Fury's order to blow up the Iliad. The fandom recap gives that order to Bobbi Morse, with Gonzales badly hurt, and Wikipedia says Morse, Gonzales, Mack and Hartley all disobeyed Fury. Rewrite?
options: Rewrite: 'Robert Gonzales commands the Iliad when Hydra rises. He and the agents with him defy Fury's order to sink the ship, saving hundreds of agents.'
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom 'One Door Closes': 'Robert Gonzales was the commander of the Iliad and was hurt badly... Morse had another mission, given to her by Nick Fury; she was to destroy the ship... Morse decided to help the others retake the ship.' Wikipedia S2#15: 'Morse, Gonzales, Mack, and Hartley disobeyed Fury's orders, saving hundreds of loyal S.H.I.E.L.D. agents.'
